content.short: Long-term portfolio of tokenized stocks, bonds and gold, open to anyone from $1.
content.description: Real Assets is built for people who want steady savings rather than crypto trading. Deposits go into a mix of 60% S&P 500 stocks, 30% physical gold and 10% US Treasuries, which users can adjust, with no minimum above $1 and withdrawals at any time. Access depends on proof of humanity through World ID rather than country, and it recently added borrowing and earning. It runs on World App and Solana Mobile.
content.meta: Hold a 60/30/10 mix of tokenized S&P 500, gold and Treasuries from $1 with Real Assets, on World App and Solana Mobile.
